proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4749 *cāmala or *cāvala explicitly gives Lahnda/Punjabi cāval, awāṇ cāvul and Bhojpuri/Maithili cāur husked rice. These survey responses match that family; the ultimate non-Aryan source remains unsettled. Exact survey form cāval is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
